text: {"fixed_clause": "In order to maintain administrative stability and operational continuity across our human resources archives, records once submitted become a part of the corporate database, while remaining subject to the data subject's rights to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion, or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed."}

data.fixed_clause: In order to maintain administrative stability and operational continuity across our human resources archives, records once submitted become a part of the corporate database, while remaining subject to the data subject's rights to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion, or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed.
